# Mage towers: one far out (generated by the current code) from outside, its rooms (as a spectator,
# so it stays asleep), the tower waking for a survivor with acolytes on every floor, the Magister
# appearing in the sanctum, and the heart going dark when it falls. Creature lists go to the log.
hud on
cmd kill @e[type=!player]
cmd time set noon
cmd gamerule doDaylightCycle false
cmd weather clear
cmd gamemode spectator
cmd tp @s -60000 150 -60000
wait 20
goto elementalarcana:mage_tower 26 18 14
wait 220
shot tower_outside
goto elementalarcana:mage_tower 4 1 2.5
wait 60
shot tower_hall
goto elementalarcana:mage_tower 3 7 8.5
wait 40
shot tower_library
goto elementalarcana:mage_tower 3 13 14.5
wait 40
shot tower_laboratory
goto elementalarcana:mage_tower 3 25 26.5
wait 40
shot tower_sanctum
# A survivor comes in: the tower wakes.
cmd arcana awaken wind
goto elementalarcana:mage_tower 4 1 2.5
wait 20
cmd gamemode survival
cmd effect give @s minecraft:resistance 300 4 true
cmd effect give @s minecraft:regeneration 300 2 true
wait 60
cmd arcana creaturelevel @e[type=elementalarcana:tower_acolyte]
wait 40
shot tower_awake_1
wait 30
shot tower_awake_2
# Up to the sanctum: the Magister appears.
goto elementalarcana:mage_tower 4 25 26.5
wait 60
cmd arcana creaturelevel @e[type=elementalarcana:tower_magister]
shot magister_1
wait 30
shot magister_2
cmd kill @e[type=elementalarcana:tower_magister]
wait 40
shot heart_dark
# The casters in a row (one Acolyte of each element, and a Magister), on a platform in the sky.
cmd gamemode creative
cmd effect clear @s
cmd tp @s 60000 161 60100 180 8
cmd fill 59990 160 60085 60010 160 60105 minecraft:smooth_stone
cmd fill 59990 161 60085 60010 170 60105 minecraft:air
wait 20
cmd summon elementalarcana:tower_acolyte 59996.5 161 60095.5 {NoAI:1b,element:0b,Rotation:[0f,0f]}
cmd summon elementalarcana:tower_acolyte 59998 161 60095.5 {NoAI:1b,element:1b,Rotation:[0f,0f]}
cmd summon elementalarcana:tower_acolyte 59999.5 161 60095.5 {NoAI:1b,element:2b,Rotation:[0f,0f]}
cmd summon elementalarcana:tower_acolyte 60001 161 60095.5 {NoAI:1b,element:3b,Rotation:[0f,0f]}
cmd summon elementalarcana:tower_acolyte 60002.5 161 60095.5 {NoAI:1b,element:4b,Rotation:[0f,0f]}
cmd summon elementalarcana:tower_magister 60004.5 161 60094.5 {NoAI:1b,element:0b,Rotation:[20f,0f]}
wait 30
shot casters
cmd kill @e[type=!player]
# The master gear, worn, with the Master Staff in hand.
cmd item replace entity @s armor.head with elementalarcana:master_hood
cmd item replace entity @s armor.chest with elementalarcana:master_robe
cmd item replace entity @s armor.legs with elementalarcana:master_trousers
cmd item replace entity @s armor.feet with elementalarcana:master_boots
cmd item replace entity @s weapon.mainhand with elementalarcana:master_staff[elementalarcana:element="fire"]
camera front
wait 20
shot master_gear
camera first
quit
